name: io.github.degentclub/scribbit-mcp
title: scribb.it: write to Bitcoin
description: Exact Bitcoin inscription quotes, commit addresses, envelope and lane facts, fees and 0x83 rescue.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_NETWORKS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated networks the tools serve (mainnet, testnet, signet, regtest). Default: all four.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_FEE_URL_MAINNET
environmentVariables.description: Mainnet fee source: a scribb.it fee server URL ending in /v1/fees or a mempool.space-compatible base URL (default https://mempool.space). "off" disables it; quotes then need feeRate.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_FEE_URL_TESTNET
environmentVariables.description: Testnet4 fee source (default https://mempool.space/testnet4); "off" disables it.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_FEE_URL_SIGNET
environmentVariables.description: Signet fee source (default https://mempool.space/signet); "off" disables it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by a scribb.it API key (bsh_live_...).

it.scribb/server.custody: none: signs, stores and broadcasts nothing
